title: Head-to-Head Player Rivalries & Historical Match Comparisons
source: PDC Head-to-Head Statistics, PDC Official Match Archives & Darts Database (dartsdatabase.co.uk)

rivalries.title: Luke Humphries vs Luke Littler
rivalries.tagline: The Premier Rivalry of Modern Darts
rivalries.record_scope: All PDC competitive meetings (Ranked majors, Premier League, World Series & European Tour)
rivalries.match_overview: A rivalry that transformed global interest in professional darts. From the unforgettable 2024 World Championship final to weekly Premier League battles, Humphries and Littler consistently produce 100+ average blockbusters.

defining_matches.summary: Littler led 4-2 in sets before Humphries unleashed a blistering 5-set streak averaging 103.67 to claim his maiden World Championship crown.
Littler hit a sensational televised nine-darter in the final to defeat the world number one and claim the £275,000 Premier League title on debut.

rivalries.tactical_analysis: Humphries relies on relentless consistency and clinical 100+ checkouts, while Littler attacks with rapid-fire 180 scoring and aggressive treble-switching.

rivalries.title: Michael van Gerwen vs Gerwyn Price
rivalries.tagline: The Green Machine vs The Iceman
rivalries.record_scope: Official PDC senior circuit matches (televised majors, Premier League & ProTour)
rivalries.match_overview: One of the fiercest, most emotionally charged rivalries in darts history. Filled with roaring celebrations, stage flexes, and epic matchplay battles.

defining_matches.summary: An extraordinary slugfest where MVG clawed back from 0-4 down to claim his third World Matchplay title with a 101.19 average.
Price's landmark breakthrough victory over MVG after 19 previous defeats, on his way to defending the Grand Slam title.

rivalries.tactical_analysis: Both players feed directly off crowd electricity and aggressive tempo. Van Gerwen dominates in rapid high-scoring bursts, whereas Price excels in grinding down opponents with heavy double-top checkouts.

rivalries.title: Gary Anderson vs Michael van Gerwen
rivalries.record_scope: Official PDC senior circuit head-to-head matches (1993–present)
rivalries.match_overview: For over a decade, Anderson vs MVG represented the gold standard of world darts: blistering throwing speed, virtually zero gamesmanship, and astronomical scoring.

defining_matches.summary: The highest-scoring final in history: 42 maximum 180s combined (Anderson 22, MVG 20), with Van Gerwen averaging 107.79 and Anderson averaging 104.93.
Anderson dismantled van Gerwen with a 104.85 average to secure his second Premier League crown.

rivalries.tactical_analysis: Zero delay on the oche. When both are firing, legs routinely finish in 11 to 13 darts with continuous 180s.

rivalries.title: Michael Smith vs Michael van Gerwen
rivalries.tagline: Architects of the Greatest Leg in History
rivalries.record_scope: Official PDC senior circuit head-to-head meetings
rivalries.match_overview: Forever etched into sporting immortality following their clash on 3 January 2023 at Alexandra Palace.

defining_matches.summary: Featured the legendary leg where MVG missed double-12 for a 9-darter, and Smith stepped up to hit double-12 for a nine-darter of his own. Smith went on to win his first world title.
Van Gerwen won his third world title with early dominance, leading 4-0 before Smith fought back.

rivalries.tactical_analysis: Pure natural rhythm versus controlled aggressive dominance. High 180 frequency across every meeting.
